critical_code_review_comments: services/rules_engine.py::emit_event — every action now goes through enqueue_or_execute even for benign actions (dock_notify, send_email, apply_credit). That's intentional but note requires_approval currently only returns True for create_purchase_order/refund/upgrade_vip_tier(downgrade)/apply_discount>25%/post_journal>2000. Consider explicitly white-listing non-risky actions so a future policy tweak doesn't accidentally queue every notification.

services/ash_intelligence.py::run_all_insights (line ~447-458) marks stale insights (not touched this run) as resolved. This is correct on periodic re-runs but means a manual dismiss done between two runs cannot be un-resolved by the next run — resolvedAt gets overwritten. Not a bug per current UX but worth documenting.

routes/audit.py::history endpoint accepts `collection` as query param via /restore + /purge but the /history/{type}/{id} route silently ignores any collection= arg — it always reads from db.entity_versions. Frontend still passes it and it works; consider dropping the param from the spec/docs to avoid confusion.

routes/ash.py::run passes include_summary as a boolean but the fifteen deterministic generators run every time — the weekly summary is behind include_summary. The Ash UI 'Run Ash Now' hits /ash/run without include_summary, so weekly must be triggered separately via /ash/summary/weekly (as designed). This is intentional but non-obvious; consider a docstring note in the endpoint.
services/approval_service.py::_env_float — casts AI_APPROVE_TIER_DOWNGRADES via _env_float then int() — a value of '0' or '1' works; anything else silently falls back to default. Fine, just brittle.
